title: 青岚风云 第146章 林越安排事宜李长老姗姗来迟青岚风云 第145章 离开灵州城赶往断云岭
slug: 凡人修仙我能无限重生
content_zh:
青岚风云第146章林越安排事宜，李长老姗姗来迟
翌日清晨，
天还没有大亮，山脚下的营地便已经热闹起来。
陆续赶来的一百多青岚宗弟子们，一个个忙得不亦乐乎，有的有的搭锅造饭，有的拿着凿子和铁锤准备开工，尽都精神抖擞，摩拳擦掌，一副想大干一场的样子。
林越看得很欣慰，他将楚昊等二十多人叫到帐篷。
这二十多人是各个分队的小队长。
林越拿出一张草图铺在地上，伸手指了指图纸上的几处红线，对着这二十多人说道，
“断云岭主段，从这道山脊到东面那片岩壁，全长约十里。石料已经到位，灵材也在路上，接下来的活儿分三组。赵虎带第一组，负责南坡基座浇筑，注意灵脉接驳点一定要对准阵眼，偏一寸后面整段都要返工。”
抬起头看了赵虎一眼，“你的传音玉符随身带好，遇到拿不准的方位，随时联系楚昊。”
赵虎用力点头，拍了拍腰间的玉符，“放心，林师兄，偏一寸我提头来见。”
他服了林越送给他的几颗灵丹后，修为一日千里，已在前不久成功筑基。
所有人都笑了出来，林越也笑了一声，道，
“倒不至于提头来见，但你要是失误了的话，我可要用门规处置你。到时候别怪我不念旧情。啊，听到了吗？赵师弟！”
“是。林师兄。”赵虎答应。
林越继续指着图纸，看了眼赵虎旁边的几个年轻弟子，
“第二组负责北坡墙体的砌筑。石层之间要用掺了灵砂的泥浆填缝，泥浆的配比我昨晚写好了单子，你们等会儿拿去看看。每砌五层用木槌夯一遍，夯不实的不算数。”
“是，林长老！”回话的是周元，他是筑基后期修为，在众弟子算修为较高的。
林越看向周元，郑重道，“周师弟，你这一组的活儿最累，但也是整段长城最重要的部分。墙体若不实，法阵再好也没用。能扛得住吗？”
“林长老放心，我们坚决完成任务。要是夯不实，我们晚上不睡觉也给它夯实了。”周元拍着胸脯道。
“嗯。”林越点头。

他看向楚昊，又说道，“第三组负责灵脉监测节点的铺设。楚师弟带这个组。节点间距和深度都已经写在图纸上了，你按着来就行。遇到底层硬岩别硬凿，绕一下过去，宁可多费半日工夫，也别把地脉凿裂了。”
“是。林师兄，我盯着他们干，保准不出岔子。”楚昊答应。
林越将草图交给楚昊，站起身，目光扫过众人，朗声道，
“还有一件事，你们应该也听说了，正气长城不止我们这一处在修。玄女宗在南线落霞谷已经开工了，金刚寺负责西段山岭，灵溪宗在赤水河沿线布置监测阵盘，灵兽宗派了阵法师到各段做技术支援。天星门虽然人少，也派了弟子去赤水河段帮着搭建哨塔。”
“太好了。”
content_en:
Qinglan Fengyun Chapter 146 Lin Yue arranged matters, but Elder Li was late
The next morning,
It's not bright yet, but the camp at the foot of the mountain is already bustling with activity.
More than a hundred Qinglan Sect disciples were arriving one after another, and they were all very busy. Some were setting up pots to make rice, and some were preparing to start work with chisels and hammers. They were all full of energy and gearing up, as if they wanted to do something big.
Lin Yue was very pleased to see it. He called Chu Hao and more than 20 people to the tent.
These twenty people are the captains of each team.
Lin Yue took out a sketch and spread it on the ground, pointed at several red lines on the drawing, and said to the more than 20 people,
"The main section of Duanyun Ridge, from this ridge to the rock wall on the east, is about ten miles in length. The stone materials are already in place and the spiritual materials are on the way. The next work is divided into three groups. Zhao Hu leads the first group and is responsible for pouring the base on the south slope. Pay attention that the spiritual vein connection point must be aligned with the formation eye. If it is off by an inch, the entire section will have to be reworked."
He raised his head and glanced at Zhao Hu, "Take your sound transmission jade talisman with you. If you encounter any uncertain directions, contact Chu Hao at any time."
Zhao Hu nodded vigorously and patted the jade talisman on his waist, "Don't worry, Senior Brother Lin, if you're just an inch away, I'll raise my head to see you."
After taking a few elixirs given to him by Lin Yue, his cultivation improved rapidly, and he had successfully built a foundation not long ago.
Everyone laughed, and Lin Yue also laughed and said,
"I'm not going to raise my head to meet you, but if you make a mistake, I will use the sect rules to deal with you. Then don't blame me for not remembering the old relationship. Ah, did you hear that? Junior Brother Zhao!"
"Yes. Senior Brother Lin." Zhao Hu agreed.
Lin Yue continued to point to the drawings and glanced at the young disciples next to Zhao Hu.
"The second group is responsible for the masonry of the north slope wall. The gaps between the stone layers must be filled with mud mixed with spiritual sand. I wrote a list of the mud ratio last night. You can take it to see later. Every fifth layer is tamped with a mallet. Those that are not tamped firmly will not be counted."
"Yes, Elder Lin!" The person who replied was Zhou Yuan. He was in the late stage of Foundation Establishment and was considered to have a higher cultivation level among the disciples.
Lin Yue looked at Zhou Yuan and said solemnly, "Junior brother Zhou, your group has the most tiring work, but it is also the most important part of the entire section of the Great Wall. If the wall is not solid, it will be useless no matter how good the magic circle is. Can it withstand it?"
"Don't worry, Elder Lin, we will resolutely complete the task. If it's not solid, we won't sleep at night to keep it solid." Zhou Yuan patted his chest and said.
"Yeah." Lin Yue nodded.
He looked at Chu Hao and said, "The third group is responsible for laying the spiritual vein monitoring nodes. Junior brother Chu leads this group. The node spacing and depth have been written on the drawing, you just have to follow it. Don't cut hard when you encounter the underlying hard rock, go around it. It is better to spend half a day more than to crack the ground veins."
"Yes. Senior Brother Lin, I will keep an eye on them and make sure nothing goes wrong." Chu Hao agreed.
Lin Yue handed the sketch to Chu Hao, stood up, glanced at everyone, and said loudly,
"One more thing, you should have heard that we are not the only ones who are building the Great Wall of Righteousness. The Xuannv Sect has started construction in the Luoxia Valley on the southern line, the Jingang Temple is responsible for the western section of the mountains, the Lingxi Sect has deployed monitoring arrays along the Chishui River, and the Spirit Beast Sect has sent array masters to each section to provide technical support. Although the Tianxing Sect has a small number of people, it has also sent disciples to help build sentry towers in the Chishui River section."
"Great."
